issue.title: Align Maestro CI/docs with Expo MCP + Maestro official guidance
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Follow-up after #497 / #510. Audit via Expo MCP + Maestro docs showed our informational GHA path is intentional (#497) but under-documented vs Expo’s canonical EAS Workflows `maestro` job.

## Scope

**In scope**
- Document Expo-canonical path (EAS Workflows + `e2e-test` profile) vs chosen GHA informational runner, with links
- Align CI Maestro CLI flags with official docs (`--test-output-dir` / `--debug-output` / JUnit)
- Keep Android-only; do **not** add merge gates or iOS

**Out of scope (separate ticket if wanted)**
- Migrating CI to EAS Workflows `type: maestro`
- Adding `e2e-test` EAS profile + `.eas/workflows/`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `docs/guides/maestro.md` cites Expo MCP E2E pages + Maestro CLI/docs and states intentional GHA deviation (#497)
- [ ] `scripts/maestro-ci-emulator.sh` uses Maestro-documented report/artifact flags
- [ ] No required PR gate; Android-only preserved

## Links

- Refs #497 #510 #488
- Expo: https://docs.expo.dev/eas/workflows/examples/e2e-tests/
- Expo: https://docs.expo.dev/tutorial/cicd/e2e-tests/
- Maestro: https://docs.maestro.dev/

comments.body: Merged via #514 (Expo/Maestro docs sources + CI notes).
